Datasheet                Data Center Switch

 DATA CENTER SWITCH
 EXP400-32X




 The Edgecore EXP400-32X is a high performance, low power, low latency, fully programmable SDN data center switch
 designed for data center, cloud, and AI networks.

 The EXP400-32X is a 32 x 400G QSFP112 port switch in a 1RU form factor. Each of the 400G QSFP112 ports can breakout
 to 2 x 200G, or 4 x 100G, optimizing compute racks by enabling 100Gbps-per-lane server links. The device is an ideal leaf or
 ToR switch for cloud data center operators that are driving the rapid adoption of compute server NICs to 400Gbps speeds.

 The EXP400-32X also supports Xsight Instruction Set Architecture (ISA) for users to deﬁne ﬂexible packet processing rules,
 routing protocols, and network policies. The programmability is also an important underlying capability for many of the
 advanced features, including queue management, congestion control, and telemetry. The programmability will handle
 newly-deﬁned notiﬁcation mechanisms, such as the Ultra Ethernet Transport (UET) protocol, packet trimming, and PFC. In
 addition, programmability allows ﬂexible, precise, and real time telemetry, supporting INT, IOAM, IFA, ERSPAN, sFlow,
 NetFlow, and Netstream, all using hardware acceleration.

 Optimized for interconnecting AI/ML, storage, and compute clusters in data centers, the EXP400-32X supports
 congestion-aware routing, which comprises measuring and signaling congestion as well as load balancing across the
 network fabric. For a given fabric link, the EXP400-32X can measure ﬂow rate, latency, and queue level. When congestion is
 detected, it can signal using Explicit Congestion Notiﬁcation (ECN), Congestion Signaling (CSIG), or other customer-deﬁned
 mechanisms. The EXP400-32X can handle ﬂowlet-based load balancing and packet spraying across fabric links, as well as
 traditional ﬂow-based approaches like ECMP.

 Key Features and Beneﬁts
 ●   Supports 12.8Tbps full-duplex throughput
 ●   Supports 100 Gbps PAM4 LR SerDes with a retimer-less design
 ●   The 32 x 400G QSFP112 ports can breakout to 2 x 200G, or 4 x 100G
 ●   Fully programmable software-deﬁned pipeline and elastic control tables enable application-speciﬁc optimization and
     in-ﬁeld updates
 ●   Supports UEC-compatible features such as congestion-aware dynamic load balancing, CSIG, packet trimming, PFC,
     and UET header parsing
 ●   Supports fast link-failure recovery, rich telemetry, advanced data-plane failure prediction, and lossless operation with
     PFC required for deployment in AI/ML clusters
 ●   Supports front-to-back airﬂow direction
 ●   All ports on front; PSUs and fans accessible from rear
 ●   Hot-swappable, load-sharing, redundant AC power.
 ●   5+1 redundant, hot-swappable fan modules
 ●   Switch pre-loaded Open Networking Install Environment (ONIE) for the automated loading of community SONiC, Xsight
     OS, or commercial NOS
